The structure of MgNb4O12 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 36 atoms and seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Nb centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while Mg adopts an octahedral environment with six O neighbors. The Nb octahedra share edges with one another and with Mg octahedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. O centers show four- or five-coordinate environments, and the neighbor graph is three-dimensional.
